body.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE vertical painted adventure world-map terrain strip, 1024x1536, made of FOUR vertically stacked contiguous REGIONS, not a finished interface. Source image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for painterly Russian fairy-tale landscapes, realistic miniature wooden villages, birches, deep pine forests, antique gold sunset light, dark navy shadows and winding river geography. Render from consistent high three-quarter aerial map view, close enough that each region is a distinct dramatic landmark, NOT distant panoramic scenery. Entire image filled with terrain; no sky or horizon. EXACTLY FOUR equal-height regions, one per vertical quarter, each with a large readable centerpiece alternating left/right. Soft organic wooded boundaries between regions, NO hard card frames or horizontal rules. Continuous narrow winding earth road connects all four regions from TOP to BOTTOM. Four landmarks must remain inside their own quarter with foliage at top/bottom edges. Keep the lowest 20% of each quarter subdued and uncluttered for separately overlaid native chapter name. Rich but controlled detail, warm lanterns, restrained highlights, legible silhouettes at phone size. NO UI, text, lettering, numbers, labels, emblems, nodes, gold dotted lines, circles, lock icons, panels, portraits, hero characters, frames, borders, watermarks. Treat narrative only as location guidance, do not render story scenes or characters. Regions top to bottom:
ZONE 1, vertical band 0-25%: The Milky Shores. Theme: Rest, friendship, and the beginning of love (or deep bond). Story setting: After the intensity of the Firebird kingdom, the road leads to soft, dream-like shores where the rivers run with milk and the banks are made of sweet jelly (a classic Russian fairy-tale image). Here the hero meets Vasilisa the Beautiful, who has been searching for a way to stop the fading of her own land.
ZONE 2, vertical band 25-50%: The Underwater Kingdom. Theme: Wonder, adaptation, new rules. Story setting: A great river leads down into the domain of the Sea Tsar. The world changes: gravity feels lighter, bubbles rise, currents push the gems in unexpected directions. New mechanics appear (floating tiles, current lanes, pearl collectors).
ZONE 3, vertical band 50-75%: The Ural Mountains. Theme: Strength, inheritance, the bogatyr spirit. Story setting: The stone belt of the Urals rises ahead. Here the hero first meets the spirit of Ilya Muromets — not yet the full legendary warrior, but a quiet, powerful presence who has been waiting for someone worthy. He trains the hero through a series of increasingly hard “strength” levels (stone obstacles, heavy chains, collapsing platforms).
ZONE 4, vertical band 75-100%: The Siberian Taiga. Theme: Loneliness, endurance, the spirits of the wild. Story setting: The endless taiga. Days of travel through snow and dark pines. The Firebird’s light is sometimes the only warmth. The hero meets a great Bear spirit who has lost his cubs to the darkness. Helping him becomes a personal quest inside the chapter.
